_meta.title: Whole prior thread quoted back below a two-word reply
_meta.expect: Message threads; the actual reply text survives. This payload (~66 KB) sits UNDER the 128 KiB intake cap (design A15 / MAIL-19), so no truncation happens here at all — the over-cap regression cases with a genuine head+tail split live in 16-bottom-posted-oversize-quote/17-top-posted-oversize-quote. Intake deliberately does not strip quoted history regardless of size: bottom-posted replies are common, and intake-side quote stripping would silently destroy the human message with no way to recover it (the raw MIME is never stored). Quote collapsing is MAIL-20 render work.
